Alex — following up with a few technical clarifications and links. Quoting Rachel's action items below.

> 1) Redwood to provide an anonymized CSV sample (fields: timestamp, req_id, model_id, latency_ms, cache_hit) — target: 12/06 EOD.

Notes: the sample will have req_id as a UUID v4 truncated to 8 chars (no PII), model_id will include family name (e.g., gpt-4-redwood) and a version tag, latency_ms measures total server-side processing time, and cache_hit is computed at the inference router (true/false). We'll also include a column "route" when requests are routed to fallback models.

> Encryption at rest & keys

Clarification: ciphertext is AES-256-GCM at the storage layer. For Private deployments, customers supply a KMS key (external CMK) and we rotate keys every 90 days by default; Redwood-managed KMS follows the same rotation schedule and supports automatic key versioning. I'll paste links to docs: 
- Key management: https://docs.redwood.com/security/keys
- Logs & retention: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/logging-retention

If you'd like the sample in NDJSON or zipped with a README, say the word and I'll generate it.

— Ben
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
